name: schemagate
description: Text-to-SQL with ~91% fewer schema tokens: a local, read-only MCP server that hands the model only the tables a question needs, and only the ones the caller may read. 74.34 EX on BIRD's hidden test set, #1 on UniQL's Oracle board. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, BigQuery, DuckDB.

SCHEMAGATE_DATABASE_URL.description: SQLAlchemy URL of the database to query, e.g. postgresql+psycopg://user:password@host/db. Enter demo to try the bundled 42-object sample schema.
